comment:
The Model and Sounds CV inputs do not offset their knobs, they override them: readSnapParam at Clang.cpp:397-404 uses the knob only when the input is unpatched, and otherwise derives the index from 0V to 10V alone. The manual lists them as 'Model CV and Sounds CV' without saying that.

In the FM engine the knob positions are remapped through clangFmModelOrder (Clang.cpp:31, 637-638), so turning Model gives Ping, Ratio, Bell, Phase, Stack, Bits, Fault, Arc rather than the declared order; the maker's comment says Arc was deliberately moved to the last position.

Tune, Tune Variation and the Tune input are all read inside triggerVoice (Clang.cpp:472-481), so they only affect hits fired after they are moved. Decay, Noise, Motion and Body are read every sample and do change a hit that is already ringing.

Body and Tune Variation have no CV input; the manual does not distinguish them from the controls that do.

Eight voices are held (Clang.cpp:20) and a new trigger takes the one with the lowest combined envelope energy (Clang.cpp:381-395).
